network: The server is local stdio. Each pinned runtime requires release metadata and archive access unless it already has a valid cache entry. Every execution, including cache-hit repeats, needs model provider access.
credentials: Codex uses its eligible existing login. The Pi variation maps M3_DOCS_PI_API_KEY to the child OPENAI_API_KEY and selects an OpenAI provider/model. Each execution has separate writable harness state; runtime acquisition does not authenticate a provider.
cleanup: MCPTestKit closes each harness and server process; managed binaries remain in the user cache unless an explicit temporary cache is supplied.
